basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old tech enthusiast from the Netherlands, currently diving into the world of FIFA Ultimate Team (FUT). I work as a junior IT consultant, which keeps me busy during the weekdays but allows me to indulge in my hobbies during the weekends. I have a strong passion for cars, especially Volkswagen models, and I'm an active member in the GolfGTI community. I also enjoy strategy games and exploring new tech gadgets. I'm single, and my typical online hours are in the evenings after work, from around 7 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, which has equipped me with a strong foundation in technology and programming. Most of my knowledge about FIFA and FUT has been self-taught through YouTube tutorials and reading online forums like futbin.
